title: Nutanix and Supermicro Take on Runaway AI Costs with Jointly Engineered System for Private Inference
summary: Supermicro servers powered by Nutanix Agentic AI are designed for enterprises to fast track deployments of AI infrastructure, secure critical on-premises GPU resources, reduce AI costs, and scale AI workloads with flexibility and control
body_markdown:
**[NVIDIA GTC](https://www.nvidia.com/gtc/) – Berlin – Oct. 21, 2026** – Nutanix (NASDAQ: NTNX), a hybrid cloud leader and AI platform company, and Super Micro Computer, Inc. (NASDAQ: SMCI), today announced plans for a jointly engineered AI infrastructure solution powered by Nutanix Agentic AI designed to help enterprises take on runaway AI costs with a system for private inference.


Built on the validated Supermicro systems powered by Nutanix Agentic AI, the solution will combine the Nutanix Cloud Platform with Supermicro servers, NVIDIA GPUs, and[NVIDIA Spectrum-X](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/networking/spectrumx/) networking. Designed to reduce custom configuration and integration complexity, it will simplify the path from infrastructure deployment to production-ready AI. Nutanix delivers a complete, full-stack AI platform engineered to simplify and accelerate the deployment of enterprise AI workloads -- from underlying infrastructure to model execution and the governance of agentic workloads. The solution will help enable seamless provisioning from bare metal to delivering integrated model-as-a-service and a secure Agent Gateway using Nutanix Kubernetes Platform -- the Cloud Native Computing Foundation certified AI conformant Kubernetes distribution -- and Nutanix Enterprise AI. The solution will be supported by Nutanix Unified Storage (NUS) which provides high-performance NVIDIA Enterprise-certified storage for AI workloads, including context caching and model serving. Together, these capabilities are intended to provide the end-to-end performance, resilience, and orchestration required to support modern AI initiatives. The built-in AI catalog will further simplify deployment by providing access to common AI applications.


As AI requirements grow, the architecture is designed to scale GPU capacity while the dedicated Nutanix control plane and storage services will support resilient operations and high-throughput data workflows. With this engineered offering, customers will be able to more easily deploy, manage, and scale AI inference workloads without having to assemble and connect a complex mix of multivendor technologies.


“ *Collaborating with Nutanix, we want to accelerate time-to-online for enterprise AI,* ” **** said **Matthew Thauberger, Chief Revenue Officer, Supermicro** . “ *Combining Supermicro’s engineered servers with Nutanix’s full-stack software will deliver a pre-validated, rack-scale solution that bypasses traditional lead-time delays. It will help give organizations predictable access to high-density GPU compute while removing the operational complexity of scaling AI.* ”


“ *Moving AI from experimentation into production remains a challenge for many enterprises, with infrastructure complexity and hardware procurement often slowing progress. Our expanded collaboration with Supermicro is a direct response to this barrier,* ” said **Thomas Cornely, Executive Vice President, Product Management, Nutanix** . “ *The Supermicro systems, engineered with our Nutanix Agentic AI full stack software, will help enterprises simplify how AI infrastructure is deployed, operated, and secured, and scaled, enabling them to simply deploy private inference and control the cost per token as AI adoption scales* .”


## Supermicro with Nutanix Cloud Platform: Reducing the Complexity of Enterprise AI Infrastructure


- The engineered solution from Supermicro and Nutanix is intended to provide a hardware foundation that helps eliminate custom-order delays by using the Supermicro server systems which houses eight NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs per node.
- The resilient single-tenant control plane is expected to feature a dedicated, resilient Nutanix management cluster (NX-8170-G10) to protect against management plane failure without disrupting GPU execution.
- For high-performance storage scaling, an integrated NUS cluster (NX-8150-G10) is optimized for high-bandwidth I/O requirements across AI data ingestion, checkpointing, and cache warming.
- NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet networking combines NVIDIA Spectrum-4 Ethernet switches (SN5610/SN5600) with NVIDIA ConnectX-7/8 SuperNICs for high-performance, predictable GPU-to-GPU scale-out connectivity and NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPUs for infrastructure offloading and in-band management, complementing NVIDIA’s scale-in networking architecture.


## Analyst Commentary


*"The AI imperative is shifting from simply building raw compute capacity to optimizing the cost and efficiency of every inference delivered. Hardware, memory, networking, model optimization, and orchestration all need to be managed as a system if organizations are going to scale inference efficiently and translate AI investment into real business outcomes."*


- **Matt Kimball, Vice President & Principal Analyst, Moor Insights & Strategy**


## Availability


The Supermicro systems powered by Nutanix Agentic AI will be available early 2027 from Supermicro and its channel partners.

### About Super Micro Computer, Inc.


Supermicro (NASDAQ: SMCI) is a global leader in Application-Optimized Total IT Solutions. Founded and operating in San Jose, California, Supermicro is committed to delivering first-to-market innovation for Enterprise, Cloud, AI, and 5G Telco/Edge IT Infrastructure. We are a Total IT Solutions provider with server, AI, storage, IoT, switch systems, software, and support services. Supermicro's motherboard, power, and chassis design expertise further enables our development and production, enabling next-generation innovation from cloud to edge for our global customers. Our products are designed and manufactured in-house (in the US, Taiwan, and the Netherlands), leveraging global operations for scale and efficiency and optimized to improve TCO and reduce environmental impact (Green Computing). The award-winning portfolio of Server Building Block Solutions® allows customers to optimize for their exact workload and application by selecting from a broad family of systems built from our flexible and reusable building blocks that support a comprehensive set of form factors, processors, memory, GPUs, storage, networking, power, and cooling solutions (air-conditioned, free air cooling or liquid cooling).
